description: World Mining Data is an annual publication of the Austrian Federal Ministry of Finance, Directorate for Mineral Resources Policy, that summarises and statistically evaluates the production of 65 mineral commodities in 168 countries. It is compiled to provide a basis for commodity forecasts and minerals policy at national and European level. Production is tabulated by commodity and by producer country, and grouped by continent, development status, per capita income, economic blocks and cartel-like associations, political stability of producer countries and concentration of production, with definitions of the commodities, weights, measures and values and a note on data capture. The data section offers Excel workbooks (total world production, production by commodity, and the grouped tables) and PDF files, in English and German, downloadable without registration; printed copies are free from the ministry. No licence is stated on the site. Caveats: figures are annual national totals, not mine-level data, and they depend on the national sources the ministry compiles. For simulation it provides country-level production series of mineral raw materials for supply-chain, concentration-risk and capacity-planning analyses of industrial inputs. Related catalogue records include the USGS Mineral Commodity Summaries and the USGS Mineral Resources Data System.
